cells: Employment Mechanism and Targets for Young People ( 18-35 years )

1. Mechanism of employment and self-employment of young people:
a). Agriculture Production including Fisheries (Providing Inputs, Market Acess)
b). Livestock Production (Breeding, Restocking)
c).  Small Grants
d). Voluntary Savings and Lending
e). Emergency Employment (Cash for Work)
f) . Access to Credit and Markets
2. Clear targets on the activities which we perceive as employment/self-employment activities:
Activity 1.1.1: Distribute agricultural inputs (seeds, fertilizers, and tools) to 20,000 IDPs and Vulnerable host community households (40% female)
Activity 1.1.2: Facilitate Access to land by IDPs, Refugees and vulnerable landless groups for agriculture activities for 5,000 farmers (40% female).
Activity 1.1.11: Provide 75 tons of pasture seeds to 4,000 households
Activity 1.1.9: Provide 200 Improved breed male goats for breeding purposes to 200 households
Activity 1.1.7: Conduct small ruminant restocking (distribute goats or sheep) to 4000 vulnerable households; 50% female.
Activity 1.1.8:  Organise 4 training sessions for 200 Youth as qualified Community Animal Workers (CAWs ) and Para Veterinary Workers.
Activity 1.2.1: Establish and or rehabilitate  6 water resources (Water yards, Haffirs, irrigation canals) for irrigation, livestock, and human consumption purposes beneting at least  6,000 people.
These are the number of people who will obtain temporal skilled and unskilled employment opportuniies duringeth construction and rehabilitation process
Activity 1.2.5: Provide 10 agricultural machinery including tractors and accessories to associations to increase production for at least 10,000 farmers.

Activity 2.1.1: Provide 15 micro-grants to vulnerable groups and associations of approximately 800 members to undertake small business and Income-generation ventures  (Microgrants can be counted as self-employment and the 800 jobs as employment.)
Activity 2.1.3: Organize emergency employment initiatives through Cash for Work for 2,500 people.
Activity 1.2.2: Provide 10 Solar Water Pumps and Accessories benefiting at least 2000 small holder producers.
Activity 2.1.4: Facilitate access to credit for associations, small businesses and other vulnerable groups
a. Medium Term Employment: Employment of 3-12 months, working 20+ hours/week, earning above the minimum wage in the country of employment
b. Sustainable Employment: Employment of a minimum of 12 months, working 20+ hours/week, earning above the minimum wage in the country of employment
c. Self-Employment: Leading an income generating activity for a minimum of 6 months as a result of receipt of a loan/ grant through the project

d. Self-Employed Freelancer: Freelancer with the tools/means and training in specialized highly requested freelancing services, with access to the right platform to offer his/her services for a minimum of one month.
